exceptions.name: @img/sharp-wasm32
exceptions.reason: sharp 0.35.x publishes @img/sharp-wasm32 without cpu/os restriction while its only parents (@img/sharp-freebsd-wasm32 os=freebsd, @img/sharp-webcontainers-wasm32 cpu=wasm32) are skipped on linux/x64; npm ci still installs it, so npm ls reports it extraneous. Verified identical in sharp 0.35.5; not removable from the lockfile (npm re-adds it).

exceptions.name: @emnapi/runtime
exceptions.reason: Sole dependency of the extraneous @img/sharp-wasm32 (see that entry); installed only because its parent is installed.
